name: Other Sales
query:
SELECT
  se.dated AS `Date`,
  se.department AS `Department`,
  SUM(se.amount) AS `Amount`
FROM `tabSales Entry` se
WHERE se.docstatus = 1
  AND se.sale_type = 'Other'
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR %(from_date)s = '' OR se.dated >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR %(to_date)s = '' OR se.dated <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(department)s IS NULL OR %(department)s = '' OR se.department = %(department)s)
GROUP BY se.dated, se.department
ORDER BY se.dated DESC
